europe_now.title: Poland Calls for Expanded Russian Diplomat Expulsions
europe_now.summary: Poland has urged the European Union to expel additional Russian diplomats following a recent security incident involving a bomb plot in Leipzig. Officials emphasize that coordinated regional responses are necessary to address escalating security threats.

sources.headline: Poland calls for EU to expel more Russian diplomats after Leipzig bomb plot

europe_now.title: Investigation into Suspected Power Substation Sabotage in Germany
europe_now.summary: German authorities are actively investigating a suspected power substation sabotage incident linked to explosive-laden drone threats. The unfolding security breach has prompted heightened surveillance and international diplomatic friction with Moscow.

sources.headline: Russia blamed for explosive-laden drone found at German airport
Germany investigates suspected power substation sabotage, Russia summons German envoy

top_stories.title: European Support for Ukraine Amid Regional Security Threats
top_stories.summary: EU and NATO leaders have publicly vowed that continued support for Ukraine will not be deterred by ongoing Russian intimidation tactics. Meanwhile, security updates highlight that Russia's rapid transition toward jet-powered drones presents an expanding threat across wider European airspace.

sources.headline: Von der Leyen, Rutte say Russian ‘intimidation will not work’ to stop Ukraine aid

top_stories.title: French President's Official Visit to the United Kingdom
top_stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron has arrived in the United Kingdom to engage in high-profile bilateral meetings alongside King Charles and British leadership. The diplomatic itinerary includes opening a special exhibition featuring the historic Bayeux Tapestry.
